title: Aura Battle
statement: The task is to minimize worst-case total loss over 10 interactive rounds: each round two integers a, b are played against a hidden x in [1, 10^4], and min(|x-a|, |x-b|) is lost and revealed; the limit is m+67 for minimax optimum m. One answer leaves at most four candidates a±p, b±p, so only the first query matters; balancing its arms 1:4:2, or brute-forcing all pairs, gives m = 2857.
